title: Dispatch: olc5.12 lifecycle reconciliation S8-S13 (successor grant inheritance, fixpoint sweep, required resolver, destroy tombstone, partial-removal refusal) (attempt 5, Sonnet)
description:
Repair attempt 5 for eshyra-olc5.12 (PR #665). READ FIRST: `bd show eshyra-olc5.12` (the DESIGN RECONCILIATION note dated 2026-10-17 is the authority for this task) and `bd show eshyra-olc5.12.11` (Sol r2 findings S8-S13 with exact reproducers, locations and closure criteria). Branch eshyra-olc5.12.12 is cut from eshyra-olc5.12 after main was merged in. Line numbers below are approximate; re-locate the code by symbol.

SCOPE: implement the reconciliation exactly. Do NOT patch the examples one at a time. Each item below is a structural rule. Before finishing, enumerate every caller and path it governs and record the enumeration in your completion notes.

1. S8 successor inherits the grant. packages/core/src/state/activeEffects.ts createUncontrolledSuccessor (~3191, INSERT ~3255): copy item_grant_json and every duration-provenance column the predecessor carries (survey the active_effect columns that finalizeEnd/refresh/itemBoundTypedDuration ~514 read). When the predecessor hands off to a successor, finalizeEnd's grant-ended anchor must not fire (it already checks successorEffectId); it fires when the successor ends. Verify that no anchor fires twice.
   refreshEffect (~7038, validation ~7125): if the effect (predecessor or successor) has a grant binding, refuse ANY duration change, with or without durationOverride/dm-adjudicated provenance. Use a clear ActiveEffectError naming end_effect as the route. Refresh that leaves the duration unchanged keeps working. Update the toolRefreshEffect.ts schema/description text if it advertises the override for grants. Withdraw the S5 override-success tests for grant-bound effects and replace them with refusal assertions. The non-grant refresh behaviour must not change.
2. S9 fixpoint world-time sweep. expireElapsedWorldEffects (~7397): replace the one-shot snapshot loop with a loop that each iteration selects the single earliest live ('active','suppressed') timed minute/hour/day row with deadline_elapsed_minutes <= elapsedMinutes (ORDER BY deadline, created_at, effect_id LIMIT 1) and finalizes it with eventElapsedMinutes = its deadline. Stop when none is due. Termination guard: if finalizeEnd reports performed=false for a row that is still selected, throw instead of spinning. Keep validateElapsedWorldRow on every selected row. Keep it inside the single transaction. Check whether expireElapsedRoundEffects/settleEffectsAtTurnBoundary have the same snapshot shape for successors. Successors are world-timed, so likely not, but record what you find. Fix the round sweep only if a real successor can be round-timed.
3. S10 resolver required. Fix the nested character addCondition context (activeEffects ~5342 / toolStartEffect projection path; domainMutations.ts ~129 builds a context). Then make `resolveRulesPack` a REQUIRED property (type `CampaignRulesPackResolver | undefined`, i.e. `resolveRulesPack: X | undefined`, not `resolveRulesPack?: X`) on EffectMutationContext and on the domain-mutation context types that feed terminal/cascade paths. Fix every compile error by forwarding the real resolver where one is available. Write `undefined` explicitly only where no resolver exists by construction, with a one-line reason comment. List those sites in your notes.
4. S11 tombstone. packages/core/src/state/inventoryLifecycle.ts destroyInventoryItem (~37) is the single choke point (callers: itemResetExecutor, domainMutations, ammunition, itemState x2). Inside its transaction, for every live active_effect whose item_grant_json binds this inventory instance, rewrite the binding to carry a source-destroyed marker (add an optional field to itemGrantColumn's codec, e.g. sourceDestroyedAt: ISO string; keep backward-compatible decode). In finalizeEnd, when the binding is tombstoned, skip applyItemCooldownAnchorEvent (there is no item to cool down) and still end normally. Audit every reader of item_grant_json (about 14 sites; grep item_grant_json and readItemGrantBinding): none may require the deleted inventory row or resolve the item's pack record when the binding is tombstoned. Do NOT refuse destruction.
5. S12 refuse partial removal. removeEffectTarget (~6020): if the effect has a grant binding and the requested target is (or its removal would close) a grant-bound linked creature/actor link, refuse before any mutation with an error routing to end_effect. Other targets of grant-bound effects, such as plain condition targets that are not the granted creature, keep current behaviour. Decide the exact predicate from the link kinds the grant binding creates, and state it in your notes.
6. S13. The test "every figurine grant binds only to its own variant, and refuses an instance with no variant" in packages/core/test/itemGrantSummons.test.ts: amortize the per-grant fresh DB/encounter setup (shared setup with per-case reset or rollback) so it runs well under budget, and keep every assertion. Only if amortizing is impossible, give it a measured explicit timeout and record the measurement.

PERMANENT EVIDENCE (generalized, over the real bundled pack carriers; no new per-example tests beyond these):
- As-spell lifecycle invariant over the five as-spell carriers (Bowl, Brazier, Censer, Stone, Elemental Gem). Cover: bind; voluntary concentration break creates a successor with the grant binding and the printed 60-minute deadline; refresh of the predecessor and of the successor with a changed duration is refused (with and without override); and the creature is absent after the deadline.
- Partition invariance for S9: for each as-spell carrier, an owner-effect cascade whose successor deadline lies inside one advance. advance_time 120 in one step versus 30+90 must give identical creature presence and live-effect sets (compare both, not just counters).
- Tombstone for both anchored carriers (Ring, Efreeti serving grant): destroy the bound instance, then advance_time past the deadline and explicit end_effect both succeed, the grant ends, and no availableAt is scheduled. Contrast with a retained (dropped) instance, which still anchors.
- remove_effect_target refusal for Ring and Efreeti, leaving state unchanged (the transaction rolls back cleanly).
- Resolver: start_effect character-condition projection with an available compatible add-on succeeds for one as-spell carrier and the Ring. Extend the existing .12.10 parity matrix with this branch rather than adding a standalone test.
Retain every exact SRD-backed deadline/anchor claim already in the suite.

VERIFY: run the focused suites first (itemGrantSummons, activeEffects, persistence, migrationLegacyAdoption), then `npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack` if any pack/importer file changed (none should), then `npm run verify:worktree` BEFORE committing. Commit on eshyra-olc5.12.12 only after an exit-0 verify.
notes:
Dispatched 2026-10-17 as a Claude Sonnet 5.5 Agent subagent in worktree .worktrees/eshyra-olc5.12.12 on branch eshyra-olc5.12.12, cut from eshyra-olc5.12 @ a3ed134b (main merged in).
COMPLETE. Commit 762067ab on eshyra-olc5.12.12 (not pushed). verify:worktree exit 0: 364 files passed/2 skipped; 6942 tests passed/3 skipped. No pack/importer file changed (verify:dnd5e-srd-pack not needed).
S8: createUncontrolledSuccessor INSERT now copies item_grant_json + duration_provenance_json verbatim (the only grant/provenance columns; combat-anchor columns n/a, successor is world-timed). finalizeEnd anchor already skips when successorEffectId set, so it fires once, when the successor ends. refreshEffect: any grant-bound effect (predecessor or successor) refuses a changed kind/amount/unit/trigger, and ANY durationOverride, naming end_effect; an unchanged re-anchor works, but for an 'as spell' binding (spellRef) a refresh that would move the printed deadline is also refused (closes successor re-anchor loophole; my reading of S8 closure, beyond the literal text). Dead grant branch removed from itemBoundTypedDuration (non-grant item-effect behaviour unchanged). toolRefreshEffect text updated. S5 override-success test withdrawn and replaced by refusal assertions.
S9: expireElapsedWorldEffects is a fixpoint: validates all live rows up front, then each iteration selects the earliest due live timed minute/hour/day row (ORDER BY deadline, created_at, effect_id LIMIT 1), finalizes at its deadline, throws if finalizeEnd reports performed=false. Single transaction. Round-sweep finding: the only absolute-time-reached uncontrolled removals in the pack are hour timers and createUncontrolledSuccessor requires unit equality, so a successor is never round-timed; expireElapsedRoundEffects/settleEffectsAtTurnBoundary left unchanged.
S10: nested character addCondition in createActiveEffect now forwards resolveRulesPack; ALSO found a second seam on the same path: domainMutations.addCondition called conditionImpliesIncapacitated/anyConditionImpliesIncapacitated without the resolver (this was the actual unavailable-add-on failure); fixed. resolveRulesPack is now required (X | undefined) on EffectMutationContext, DomainMutationContext, RestContext, AmmunitionMutationContext, all encounterCombatants input/ctx types, and the resolver params of conditionImpliesIncapacitated, anyConditionImpliesIncapacitated, requireConcentrationCapableOwner, lookupCreatureRecord. Forwarded from ToolContext in 17 orchestrator tools (claim/give/reacquire/transfer/remove_item/remove_condition/grant_temp_hp/set_plot_flag/set_world_fact/update_clock/suppress/unsuppress/rest finish/expend+recover ammunition/recast/transition). Explicit-undefined sites: exactly one - auditActiveEffectIntegrity's requireConcentrationCapableOwner call (read-only integrity audit, signature carries no resolver, no production caller). Note tests are not type-checked (tsconfig include src), so test fixtures omitting the key are unaffected at runtime.
S11: new state/itemGrantBinding.ts owns the binding codec (+ optional sourceDestroyedAt, backward compatible) and tombstoneItemGrantBindings; destroyInventoryItem (single choke point: itemResetExecutor, domainMutations, ammunition, itemState x2) tombstones every live bound effect in its transaction. finalizeEnd skips the cooldown anchor for a tombstoned binding. Reader audit of item_grant_json: readItemGrantBinding (finalizeEnd, successor create, refresh), duplicate-bind check in validateItemGrantBinding (compares instance ids only), grantHasCooldownAnchor (reached only for un-tombstoned legacy bindings), itemBoundTypedDuration grant branch (removed), create-time INSERT. None needs the deleted row for a tombstoned binding. Only other inventory DELETE is itemAdoption (legacy no-packRef rows, cannot be grant-bound). Destruction not refused. Module added to remove_item runtimeOwner in deterministicCapabilityInventory.ts (module-disposition test).
S12 predicate: removeEffectTarget refuses, before any mutation, when the effect has a grant binding AND the requested non-scope target currently owns an ACTIVE link of link_kind 'actor' (the link kind a grant creates for its creature). Plain condition targets / other targets of a grant-bound effect keep current behaviour. Tool description updated.
S13: figurine variant loop uses one shared setup with SAVEPOINT/ROLLBACK per grant, all assertions kept (~0.5s).
Evidence added (itemGrantSummons.test.ts, 77 tests now): per-carrier x5 S8 lifecycle (bind, refresh predecessor/successor refused with/without override incl. deadline-moving re-anchor, break creates successor with 60 deadline, absent after deadline); per-carrier x5 S9 partition invariance (120 vs 30+90, 30+30+60, 45+75, 61+59 comparing presence and live effect set); S11 tombstone x2 carriers (destroyed + advance_time, destroyed + end_effect, dropped contrast availableAt 1500); S12 refusal x2 carriers (snapshot unchanged, other target removable); S10 resolver: new entry in the .12.10 Ring parity matrix (base and add-on) plus one Bowl branch on the same matrix describe. Withdrawn: S5 override-success assertion for the grant-bound figurine (now refusal). Existing SRD deadline/anchor tests retained.
Follow-ups: none filed.
